build_glm4v_conditional_model: build a GLM-4.1V/4.6V multimodal model with vision encoder and language model for inference
create_glm4v_vision_transformer: create a vision transformer with patch embedding, attention blocks, and rotary position embeddings for image/video processing
process_glm4v_multimodal_inputs: process image and video inputs with pixel values, grid dimensions, and generate multimodal embeddings
run_glm4v_forward_pass: run the forward pass of GLM-4V model with input tokens, mrope positions, and multimodal embeddings
load_glm4v_hf_weights: load HuggingFace-compatible weights into GLM-4V model with automatic prefix mapping and weight loading
